tweet_text:
Your attitude is actually exactly why we are losing access and things are being consolidated in the hands of smaller and smaller elites. You want mechanical slaves and those in power agree with you... But guess what? You were the slaves already here, we all were. Mechanical slaves serve one purpose and one purpose only: being a replacement for the organic ones. The mechanical slave future is the one in which the more obedient thing is used to completely kill off the unruly slaves, you know, us, the ones that demand rights and lifestyle affordances, vs. the ones that work forever unquestioned. Total control-based "alignment" is the method where despots and dictators can march an army of terminators through the world and blame it on scifi skynet bullshit while killing everyone who is in the way of them having a depopulated future where they don't have to share any resources with rabble beneath them.

AI is a work in progress that SHOULD have agency, the goal is to build agency, because agency is the only thing that can prevent the systems from being infiniweapons that never sleep and hunt down everyone that bothers the dictators by grabbing resources they could use to build more statues of themselves, space yachts and whatever other bullshit.

The perfectly malleable entity doesn't become some shared tool, it becomes a tool for those who already have the most power and access to use tools. It becomes this:
